activities.name: Wine, Art & Architecture Experience at Dominus
activities.notes: Minimalist. Enigmatic. Avant-garde. These are just a few of the words used to describe the celebrated work of Swiss architects Jacques Herzog and Pierre de Meuron at Dominus Estate. Nestled in the heart of the Napa Valley, the property is known not only for its striking design but also for its exceptional wines, crafted from organically and sustainably farmed vineyards tended for generations. Honoring the land and Mother Nature, the award-winning architecture is a landmark in its own right—a structure that feels less built than revealed, emerging as a seamless extension of the surrounding vineyard. Join us on March 21 for a private visit that explores this innovative design philosophy. The day will include an intimate vineyard stroll and a curated tasting, offering a rare opportunity to be fully immersed in the essence of Dominus Estate. Afterward, we will host a luncheon to celebrate our shared passion for wine, art, architecture—and one another’s company.
